needs.what: a block_restriction whose `blockers` filter compares the blocker's power against the SOURCE creature's current (derived) power -- "creatures with power less than this creature's power can't block it" -- e.g. a power clause whose value is the source's power rather than a printed integer
needs.why_existing_wont_do: block_restriction's `blockers` filter is read by matches_static, whose `power` clause goes through characteristics.compare_pt, which takes only a plain integer `value` (the loader enforces it); there is no way to say 'less than the source's power', and the source's power changes with prowess so no constant is correct

needs.what: the Adventure half Grove's Bounty ({X}{G} Sorcery -- Adventure): distribute X +1/+1 counters among any number of target creatures you control, on a SPELL with X as the amount; the packet also carries neither a back_face nor the adventure text in oracle_text, so the second_face entry cannot be authored from the packet
needs.why_existing_wont_do: distribute_counters exists but the packet's notes restrict it to activated abilities with a printed amount ('Not available on spells or triggered abilities'), so an X-sized distribution among any number of targets on a sorcery has no expression
